name: killswitch
description: Live usage rails, forecast and history; warns at 90%, asks Claude to wrap up at 97%, stops all sessions at 99% of the 5-hour or weekly limit, and resumes after the reset

threshold.title: Stop at (%)
threshold.description: The killswitch stops all work when the 5-hour or weekly limit reaches this percent.

warnAt.title: Warn at (%)
warnAt.description: A heads-up toast when a limit passes this percent.

wrapUpAt.title: Ask Claude to wrap up at (%)
wrapUpAt.description: Past this percent, Claude is told to finish its current step and keep a handoff note.

autoResume.title: Resume automatically after the reset
autoResume.description: When the limit resets, the stopped session continues the work by itself.
